name: Context、Plan、Validator 与 Tool Gateway 合同

properties: canonical JSON SHA-256 binds task, question, constraints, whitelist, budget, evidence refs, stop conditions, builder version and input refs
constraint ids are stable by include/exclude/hard kind and ordinal
allowed_actions is exactly tool_call and finish
max_search_actions is restricted to one or two
strict root and action keys; unknown fields fail closed
one or two typed SearchArguments plus one finish action
context SHA-256 binding and canonical proposal SHA-256 self-check
expected Evidence and frozen constraint references retained per tool action

deterministic_checks: unique action ids and duplicate normalized query rejection
at least one and at most two searches
known and collectively acknowledged constraint refs
plan_validator.accepted_output: ValidatedPlan with required budget, authorized search action ids and validation SHA-256
plan_validator.rejected_output: stable PlanViolation codes and no ValidatedPlan

behavior: revalidates the exact ContextBundle and PlanProposal on every dispatch
dispatches only a tool_call action present in the accepted plan
cannot dispatch finish or an unknown action
requires ToolResult tool_id and action_id to match the authorized action
tool_gateway.runtime_boundary: W4.2 uses only a fake handler; W3 Budget reservation, SQLite attempt ownership and Artifact publication are not integrated yet

adversarial_validation.expected: plan rejected and fake tool calls=0
parser rejects the plan before dispatch
plan rejected against the exact frozen ContextBundle

compileall.command: uv run --frozen python -m compileall -q src tests

governance_cross_check.cause: git status quoted Chinese paths with octal escapes, so the allowlist parser reported false unexpected paths

known_boundaries: Constraint refs prove explicit acknowledgement, not semantic equivalence between a search query and the referenced natural-language constraint.
PlanBudget validates a frozen remaining-budget snapshot; it does not reserve or write the W3 authoritative Budget ledger.
Tool Gateway has only been exercised with an in-memory fake handler, not ArxivSearchAdapter, SQLite, Step/Attempt/Lease or Artifact lineage.
No Planner Provider output, prompt, Context Artifact, Plan Artifact, recovery path or quality comparison has been executed.
The 700-line planning contract module is frozen for W4.2; W4.3 must use its separately allowed runtime modules rather than expanding it into a workflow implementation.
evidence_boundary: W4.2 proves deterministic planning contracts and fake Tool Gateway fail-closed behavior only. It does not prove an LLM can produce valid plans, that Runtime budgets are enforced around Agent actions, that a durable L2 workflow recovers, that research quality improves, or that live Agent capability exists.
next_acceptance_point: W4.3 static two-slot durable L2 execution; no Runtime or CLI integration begins until the user explicitly enters W4.3
